reason: Driven and harvested on all four combinations (v=paper and v=ink, state=unfurl and state=publish) at 1440x960, plus the draft branch (owner-draft -> Publish, both grounds). Every one is identical. Card paints: "MARA & FINN" / "79" / "days away when this was sent" / "Wedding day, Saturday 3 October 2026" / "timeline.signalstudio.ie". aria-label on a.b-unfurl: "Mara & Finn, 79 days to Saturday 3 October 2026". The finding is factually right on every load-bearing point. (1) The qualifier is inaudible. The author's own comment at render-b.js:1725 states the mechanism - "An aria-label on an anchor REPLACES its contents, so the 64px figure and the date were announced to nobody" - and a link is a name-from-content object presented as a single node, so "when this was sent" reaches no AT user at all. (2) The comment on that same line says the name is "Built from what the card shows", and it verifiably is not: it is a rephrase that drops BOTH the honesty qualifier and the day's own name ("Wedding day"), and substitutes "days to" - a bare present-tense distance - for the one construction render-b.js:1714-1717 documents as the reason the figure is allowed to stay: "the card has to be true a month later ... the sentence under it says when it was true." So the seat is not arguing against the honesty device; it found the one place the device was not applied, on the surface whose entire premise is being read after it has gone stale. (3) Not a gate restatement. interaction-check.mjs:1636 ("the card announces what it shows") asserts only card.label.indexOf(figure) >= 0 - the digits appear somewhere in the string - which the broken label passes; nothing in either gate touches .b-ogDate or .b-unfurlTitle against the name. Lines 705-730 assert href, display, ground, radius and box only. (4) Not settled. SETTLED.md's unfurl entries are unfurl-plate-padding (geometry) and the round-7 publish-headline ruling; neither is this. (5) Constraint-clean: copy only, no colour, no weight, no architecture. (6) The fix does not make it worse - it makes the name one grammar with the object it names, and the length cost is about twenty characters on a name that is already read as one unit. The seat's proposed formula is right for the ahead branch but drops the word in the non-ahead branch, where the card paints .b-ogWord ("Today" / "The day"); sharpened below to cover it. Small defect, real, specific, one line - and at a 9.5 bar an accessible name that states a cached figure in exactly the tense the visible copy was rewritten to avoid is the kind of seam Linear or Stripe would close.
sharpenedFix: In card() (render-b.js:1723-1731), build the accessible name from the same strings the card paints, both branches. Hoist the two figure strings so the name and the DOM cannot drift: for said.state === "ahead", figureLine = said.num + " " + said.unit + " away when this was sent"; otherwise word = (said.state === "today" ? said.word : "The day") and figureLine = word. Then "aria-label": F.project.name + ", " + figureLine + ". " + (F.project.primaryDate.label ? F.project.primaryDate.label + ", " : "") + when - giving "Mara & Finn, 79 days away when this was sent. Wedding day, Saturday 3 October 2026". Keep the empty-label guard, since owner-empty leaves primaryDate.label as "" on purpose. Write the gate assertion first, in the existing unfurl loop at interaction-check.mjs:1622-1638 (already both grounds) and again for state=publish and for the owner-draft -> Publish branch: harvest .b-ogDate and .b-unfurlTitle textContent and assert the aria-label contains each verbatim, replacing the current digits-only check, so the name can never again say something the card does not.
